title: Hanuma makes up his mind to set fire the city of Lanka
introduction: Hanuma, with his blazing tail comes out and flits over the horses in Lanka, making up his mind to set fire to the city of Lanka which is the only work let for him to do. Hanuma burns the entire city, barring the abode of Vibhishana. All the demons were frightened o seeing the blazing fire, consuming their city with its trees, houses and a host of living beings. Surprised to see the city burning, the celestials and musicians (Gandharvas) gain a great delight.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे चतुःपञ्चाशः सर्गः
Thus completes 54th Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
वीक्षमाणः ततो लन्काम् कपिः कृत मनो रथः |
वर्धमान समुत्साहः कार्य शेषम् अचिन्तयत्
verses.iast:
vīkṣamāṇaḥ tato lankām kapiḥ kṛta mano rathaḥ |
vardhamāna samutsāhaḥ kārya śeṣam acintayat
verses.translation: Then, after fulfilling his heart's wish, Hanuma, looking over Lanka, thought about the remaining act to be done, with an augmented energy.

glosses.meaning: about the remaining act to be done

verses.devanagari:
किम् नु खल्व् अविशिष्टम् मे कर्तव्यम् इह साम्प्रतम् |
यत् एषाम् रक्षसाम् भूयः सम्ताप जननम् भवेत्
verses.iast:
kim nu khalv aviśiṣṭam me kartavyam iha sāmpratam |
yat eṣām rakṣasām bhūyaḥ samtāpa jananam bhavet
verses.translation: "Which act indeed is remaing nowto be done by me here, that may further create anguish to these demons?"

verses.devanagari:
वनम् तावत् प्रमथितम् प्रकृष्टा राक्षसा हताः |
बल एक देशः क्षपितः शेषम् दुर्ग विनाशनम्
verses.iast:
vanam tāvat pramathitam prakṛṣṭā rākṣasā hatāḥ |
bala eka deśaḥ kṣapitaḥ śeṣam durga vināśanam
verses.translation: "I have demolished the garden. I have killed excellent demons. I destroyed a portion of the army. The demolition of the fort is still remaining."

glosses.meaning: has been destroyed durgavinaashanam = the demolition of the fort

verses.devanagari:
दुर्गे विनाशिते कर्म भवेत् सुख परिश्रमम् |
अल्प यत्नेन कार्ये अस्मिन् मम स्यात् सफलः श्रमः
verses.iast:
durge vināśite karma bhavet sukha pariśramam |
alpa yatnena kārye asmin mama syāt saphalaḥ śramaḥ
verses.translation: "When the fort gets destroyed, the task (of Rama's battle) will be devoid of fatigue. Even with a small effort in this task, the work will become fruitful."

verses.devanagari:
यो हि अयम् मम लान्गूले दीप्यते हव्य वाहनः |
अस्य सम्तर्पणम् न्याय्यम् कर्तुम् एभिः गृह उत्तमैः
verses.iast:
yo hi ayam mama lāngūle dīpyate havya vāhanaḥ |
asya samtarpaṇam nyāyyam kartum ebhiḥ gṛha uttamaiḥ
verses.translation: "It is justified to satisfy this blazing flame on my tail, by feeding it to the full, with these excellent houses (in the city of Lanka)."

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रदीप्त लान्गूलः सविद्युत् इव तोयदः |
भवन अग्रेषु लन्काया विचचार महाकपिः
verses.iast:
tataḥ pradīpta lāngūlaḥ savidyut iva toyadaḥ |
bhavana agreṣu lankāyā vicacāra mahākapiḥ
verses.translation: Then, Hanuma, with his burning tail, strolled over the house-tops of Lanka, like a cloud charged with lightning.

glosses.meaning: like a cloud charged with lightning.

verses.devanagari:
गृहाद्गृहम् राक्षसानामुद्यानानि च वानरः |
वीक्षमाणो ह्यसम्त्रस्तः प्रासादांश्च चचार सः
verses.iast:
gṛhādgṛham rākṣasānāmudyānāni ca vānaraḥ |
vīkṣamāṇo hyasamtrastaḥ prāsādāṃśca cacāra saḥ
verses.translation: Surveying the gardens and lofty palatial mansions, that Hanuma, without fear, passed from one house to another, of the demons.

verses.devanagari:
अवप्लुत्य महावेगः प्रहस्तस्य निवेशनम् |
अग्निम् तत्र स निक्षिप्य श्वसनेन समो बली
ततोऽन्यत्पुप्लुवे वेश्म महापार्श्वस्य वीर्यवान् |
मुमोच हनुमान् अग्निम् काल अनल शिखा उपमम्
verses.iast:
avaplutya mahāvegaḥ prahastasya niveśanam |
agnim tatra sa nikṣipya śvasanena samo balī
tato'nyatpupluve veśma mahāpārśvasya vīryavān |
mumoca hanumān agnim kāla anala śikhā upamam
verses.translation: Jumping down on Prahasta's house, the valiant Hanuma, with great swiftness, having strength equal to wind, scattering fire on it, jumped over from there, to another house belonging to Mahaparsva. Hanuma, with great swiftness, having strength equal to wind, scattering fire on it, jumped over from there, to another house belonging to Mahaparsva. Hanuma scattered a fire there resembling a flame of fire that is to destroy the world.

glosses.meaning: resembling a flame of fire that is to destroy the world

verses.devanagari:
वज्रदंष्ट्र स्य च तदा पुप्लुवे स महाकपिः |
शुकस्य च महातेजाः सारणस्य च धीमतः
verses.iast:
vajradaṃṣṭra sya ca tadā pupluve sa mahākapiḥ |
śukasya ca mahātejāḥ sāraṇasya ca dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: That Hanuma, of great splendour, then leapt to the houses of Vajradamshtra, Shuka and Sarana, the intelligent.

verses.devanagari:
तथा चेन्द्रजितो वेश्म ददाह हरियूथपः |
जम्बुमालेः सुमालेश्च ददाह भवनम् ततः
रश्मिकेतोश्च भवनम् सूर्यशत्रोस्तथैव च |
ह्रस्वकर्णस्य दंष्ट्रस्य रोमशस्य च रक्षसः
युद्धोन्मत्तस्य मत्तस्य ध्वजग्रीवस्य रक्षसः |
विद्युज्जिह्वस्य घोरस्य तथा हस्तिमुखस्य च
कराळस्य पिशाचस्य शोणिताक्षस्य चैव हि |
कुम्भकर्णस्य भवनम् मकराक्षस्य चैव हि
यज्ञशत्रोश्च भवनम् ब्रह्मशत्रोस्तथैव च|
नरान्तकस्य कुम्भस्य निकुम्भस्य दुरात्मनः
वर्जयित्वा महातेजा विभीषणगृहम् प्रति |
क्रममाणः क्रमेणैव ददाह हरिपुङ्गवः
verses.iast:
tathā cendrajito veśma dadāha hariyūthapaḥ |
jambumāleḥ sumāleśca dadāha bhavanam tataḥ
raśmiketośca bhavanam sūryaśatrostathaiva ca |
hrasvakarṇasya daṃṣṭrasya romaśasya ca rakṣasaḥ
yuddhonmattasya mattasya dhvajagrīvasya rakṣasaḥ |
vidyujjihvasya ghorasya tathā hastimukhasya ca
karāLasya piśācasya śoṇitākṣasya caiva hi |
kumbhakarṇasya bhavanam makarākṣasya caiva hi
yajJṇaśatrośca bhavanam brahmaśatrostathaiva ca |
narāntakasya kumbhasya nikumbhasya durātmanaḥ
varjayitvā mahātejā vibhīṣaṇagṛham prati |
kramamāṇaḥ krameṇaiva dadāha haripuṇ^gavaḥ
verses.translation: Leaving the house of Vibhishana, Hanuma of great splendour, went successively to the houses of Rashmiketu, Surya shatru, Hrasvakarna, Damshtra, Romasha the demon, Yuddhonmatta, Matta, Dhvajagreeva the demon, the terrific Vidyujjihva, Hastimukha, Karala, Pishacha, Shonitaaksha, Kumbhakarna, Makaraksha, Yajnashatru, Brahmashatru, Narantaka, Kumbha as also the evil-minded Nikumbha and burnt the houses.

glosses.meaning: and the house of the evil minded Nikumbha.

verses.devanagari:
तेषु तेषु महार्हेषु भवनेषु महायशाः |
गृहेष्वृद्धिमतामृद्धिम् ददाह स महाकपिः
verses.iast:
teṣu teṣu mahārheṣu bhavaneṣu mahāyaśāḥ |
gṛheṣvṛddhimatāmṛddhim dadāha sa mahākapiḥ
verses.translation: That Hanuma of great fame burnt away wealth in the mansions of the rich.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वेषाम् समतिक्रम्य राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वीर्यवान् |
आससादाथ लक्ष्मीवान् रावणस्य निवेशनम्
verses.iast:
sarveṣām samatikramya rākṣasendrasya vīryavān |
āsasādātha lakṣmīvān rāvaṇasya niveśanam
verses.translation: Having passed over all the houses, the mighty and glorious Hanuma thereafter approached the house of Ravana the king of demons.

glosses.meaning: of Ravana the king of demons.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तस्मिन् गृहे मुख्ये नानारत्नविभूषिते |
मेरुमन्दरसंकाशे सर्वमङ्गळशोभिते
प्रदीप्तमग्निमुत्सृज्य लाङ्गूलाग्रे प्रतिष्ठितम् |
ननाद हनुमान् वीरो युगान्तजलदो यथा
verses.iast:
tatastasmin gṛhe mukhye nānāratnavibhūṣite |
merumandarasaṅkāśe sarvamaṇ^gaLaśobhite
pradīptamagnimutsṛjya lāṇ^gūlāgre pratiṣṭhitam |
nanāda hanumān vīro yugāntajalado yathā
verses.translation: Thereafter, scattering a blazing fire located at the tip of his tail, on that principal house, decorated with various kinds of precious stones, resembling Mounts Meru and Mandara as also embellished with all good work, the valiant Hanuma roared like a cloud thundering at noon-time in a rainy season.

glosses.meaning: at the tip of his tail
decorated with various kinds of precious stones
and embellished with all good work
like a cloud thundering at noon-time in rainy season.

verses.devanagari:
श्वसनेन च सम्योगात् अतिवेगो महाबलः |
काल अग्निः इव जज्वाल प्रावर्धत हुत अशनः
verses.iast:
śvasanena ca samyogāt ativego mahābalaḥ |
kāla agniḥ iva jajvāla prāvardhata huta aśanaḥ
verses.translation: In contact with the wind, the fire escalated with a great speed and intensity, blazing like a fire that is to destroy the world.

glosses.meaning: like a fire that is to destroy the world.

verses.devanagari:
प्रदीप्तम् अग्निम् पवनः तेषु वेश्मसु चारयत् |
अभूच्छ्वसनसम्योगादतिवेगो हुताशनः
verses.iast:
pradīptam agnim pavanaḥ teṣu veśmasu cārayat |
abhūcchvasanasamyogādativego hutāśanaḥ
verses.translation: The wind carried the blazing fire to other houses. In conjunction with the wind, the fire became very swift.

verses.devanagari:
तानि कान्चन जालानि मुक्ता मणिमयानि च |
भवनानि अवशीर्यन्त रत्नवन्ति महान्ति च
verses.iast:
tāni kāncana jālāni muktā maṇimayāni ca |
bhavanāni avaśīryanta ratnavanti mahānti ca
verses.translation: Those large houses, with golden windows, embedded with pearls, gems and precious jewels were shattered to pieces.

verses.devanagari:
सम्जज्ञे तुमुलः शब्दो राक्षसानाम् प्रधावताम् |
स्वग्ऱिहस्य परित्राणे भग्नोत्साहोर्जिअश्रियाम्
नूनेमेषाऽग्निरायातः कपिरूपेण हा इति |
verses.iast:
samjajJṇe tumulaḥ śabdo rākṣasānām pradhāvatām |
svagRihasya paritrāṇe bhagnotsāhorjiaśriyām
nūnemeṣā'gnirāyātaḥ kapirūpeṇa hā iti |
verses.translation: The demons, who were running hither and thither to protect their houses and who lost their spirits and abundant wealth, created a tumultuous nose, saying "Alas! The fire-god has come really in a form of this monkey!"

glosses.meaning: in the form of a monkey!"
who lost their energy and abundant wealth.

verses.devanagari:
क्रन्दन्त्यः सहसा पेतुः स्तनंधयधराः स्त्रियः
काश्चिरग्निपरीतेभ्यो हर्म्येभ्यो मुक्तमूर्धजाः |
पतन्त्यो रेजिरेऽभ्रेभ्यः सौदामिन्य इवाम्बरात्
verses.iast:
krandantyaḥ sahasā petuḥ stanaṃdhayadharāḥ striyaḥ
kāściragniparītebhyo harmyebhyo muktamūrdhajāḥ |
patantyo rejire'bhrebhyaḥ saudāminya ivāmbarāt
verses.translation: Some women crying and carrying their suckling's with their hair dishevelled, fell down from their houses, which were enveloped with fire, and shone like flashes of lightning falling from clouds in the sky.

verses.devanagari:
वज्र विद्रुम वैदूर्य मुक्ता रजत सम्हितान् |
विचित्रान् भवनात् धातून् स्यन्दमानान् ददर्श सः
verses.iast:
vajra vidruma vaidūrya muktā rajata samhitān |
vicitrān bhavanāt dhātūn syandamānān dadarśa saḥ
verses.translation: That Hanuma saw molten metals mixed with diamonds, corals, cat's eye-gems, pearls and silver, surging from every marvellous house.

glosses.itrans: vajra vidruma vaiduurya muktaa rajata samhitaan
glosses.iast: vajra vidruma vaidūrya muktā rajata samhitān
glosses.devanagari: वज्र विद्रुम वैदूर्य मुक्ता रजत सम्हितान्

verses.devanagari:
न अग्निः तृप्यति काष्ठानाम् तृणानाम् च यथा तथा |
हनूमान् राक्षस इन्द्राणाम् वधे किंचिन् न तृप्यति
न हनूमद्विशस्तानाम् राक्षसानाम् वसुन्धरा |
verses.iast:
na agniḥ tṛpyati kāṣṭhānām tṛṇānām ca yathā tathā |
hanūmān rākṣasa indrāṇām vadhe kiṃcin na tṛpyati
na hanūmadviśastānām rākṣasānām vasundharā |
verses.translation: As the fire does not get satisfied with any amount of firewood and straw fed to it, Hanuma was not wearied in killing any number of demons. The earth was not then wearied in receiving the number of demons killed by Hanuma (in her lap).

glosses.meaning: killed by Hanuma (receiving in her lap)

verses.devanagari:
क्वचित्किंशुकसम्काशाः क्वचिच्छाल्मलिसन्निभाः
क्वचित्कुङ्कुमसम्काशाः शिखा वह्नेश्चकाशिरे |
verses.iast:
kvacitkiṃśukasamkāśāḥ kvacicchālmalisannibhāḥ
kvacitkuṇ^kumasamkāśāḥ śikhā vahneścakāśire |
verses.translation: Flames of fire glittered like Kimshuka flowers at some places, blossoms of Shalmali tree at some places and like saffron-flowers at some other places.

glosses.meaning: like blossoms of Shalmali tree (Salmalia malabarica)

verses.devanagari:
हनूमता वेगवता वानरेण महात्मना |
लङ्कापुरम् प्रदग्धम् तद्रुद्रेण त्रिपुरम् यथा
verses.iast:
hanūmatā vegavatā vānareṇa mahātmanā |
laṇ^kāpuram pradagdham tadrudreṇa tripuram yathā
verses.translation: The high souled Hanuma, the swift monkey scorched the city of Lanka, as Rudra scorched the city of Tripura.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तु लङ्कापुरपर्वताग्रे |
स्मुत्थितो भीमपराक्रमोऽग्निः |
प्रसार्य चूडावलयम् प्रदीप्तो |
हनूमता वेगवता विसृष्टः
verses.iast:
tatastu laṇ^kāpuraparvatāgre |
smutthito bhīmaparākramo'gniḥ |
prasārya cūḍāvalayam pradīpto |
hanūmatā vegavatā visṛṣṭaḥ
verses.translation: Then, the fire having a terrific prowess, diffused by the swift Hanuma, stretching out a circle of flames, blazed and rose up to the summit of the mountain on which the city of Lanka.

glosses.meaning: to the summit of the mountain on which the city of Lanka was situated.

verses.devanagari:
युगान्तकालानलतुल्यवेगः |
समारुतोऽग्निर्ववृधे दिवस्पृक् |
विधूमरश्मिर्भवनेषु सक्तो |
रक्षः शरीराज्यसमर्पितार्चिः
verses.iast:
yugāntakālānalatulyavegaḥ |
samāruto'gnirvavṛdhe divaspṛk |
vidhūmaraśmirbhavaneṣu sakto |
rakṣaḥ śarīrājyasamarpitārciḥ
verses.translation: That fire diffused on those buildings, together with the wind picked up a speed equal to that of a fire at the time of dissolution of the world. It grew taller, touching the sky with a smokeless splendour. Those flames of fire shot up, as inflamed by ghee

glosses.meaning: having a speed equal to the fire at the time of dissolution of the world
with flames consigned to the bodies of demons like a ghee.

verses.devanagari:
आदित्यकोटीसदृशः सुतेजा |
लङ्काम् समस्ताम् परिवार्य तिष्ठन् |
शब्दैरनेकैरशनिप्ररूडै |
र्भिन्दन्निवाण्डम् प्रबभौ महाग्निः
verses.iast:
ādityakoṭīsadṛśaḥ sutejā |
laṇ^kām samastām parivārya tiṣṭhan |
śabdairanekairaśaniprarūḍai |
rbhindannivāṇḍam prababhau mahāgniḥ
verses.translation: The great fire persisted, surrounding the entire Lanka, having a good splendour equal to that of millions of suns and blazed like a broken-up hemi-sphere of the world, creating many sounds of a wide-spread thunderbolt.

glosses.meaning: equal to that of a crore of suns
like a broken-up hemi-sphere of the world

verses.devanagari:
तत्राम्बरादग्निरतिप्रवृद्धो |
रूक्षप्रभः किंशुकपुष्पचूडाः |
निर्वाणधूमाकुलराजयश्च |
नीलोत्पलाभाः प्रचकाशिरेऽभ्राः
verses.iast:
tatrāmbarādagniratipravṛddho |
rūkṣaprabhaḥ kiṃśukapuṣpacūḍAḥ |
nirvāṇadhūmākularājayaśca |
nīlotpalābhāḥ pracakāśire'bhrāḥ
verses.translation: The fire with a fierce splendour there, extended fully to the sky, shooting flames like Kumshuka flowers. The clouds, bearing the colour of blue lotuses, shone as covered by smoke formed out of the extinguished fire.

glosses.meaning: bearing the colour of blue lotuses
as covered by smoke formed out of extinguished fire.

verses.devanagari:
वज्री महेन्द्रस्त्रिदशेश्वरो वा |
साक्षाद्यमो वा वरुणोऽनिलो वा |
रुद्रोग्निरर्को धनदश्च सोमो |
न वानरोऽयम् स्वयमेव कालः |
verses.iast:
vajrī mahendrastridaśeśvaro vā |
sākṣādyamo vā varuṇo'nilo vā |
rudrognirarko dhanadaśca somo |
na vānaro'yam svayameva kālaḥ |
verses.translation: "He is not a monkey. He is either Indra the Lord of celestials wielding a thunderbolt, or Yama the lord of death of water, or the wind-god or the fire seated in the third eye of Lord Shiva or the sun-god or Kubera the lord of riches or the moon-god. He may be Kala (the Time-spirit) himself."

glosses.meaning: or Yama the lord of death appearing before the eyes
or Varuna the lord of water
seated in the third eye of Lord Shiva
or Kubera the lord of riches
he may be Kala (the Time-spirit) himself.

verses.devanagari:
किम् ब्रह्मण सर्वपितामहस्य |
सर्वस्य धातुश्चतुराननस्य |
इहागतो वानररूपधारी |
रक्षोपसम्हारकरः प्रतापः
verses.iast:
kim brahmaṇa sarvapitāmahasya |
sarvasya dhātuścaturānanasya |
ihāgato vānararūpadhārī |
rakṣopasamhārakaraḥ pratāpaḥ
verses.translation: "Whether the rage of four-faced Brahma, the grand father of all and the creator of all has arrived here in the guise of a monkey, playing the role of a destroyer of demons?"

glosses.meaning: in the guise of a monkey
playing the role of a destroyer of demons?.

verses.devanagari:
किम् वैष्णवम् वा कपिरूपमेत्य |
रक्षोविनाशाय परम् सुतेजः |
अनन्तमव्यक्तमचिन्त्यमेकम् |
स्वमायया साम्प्रतमागतम् वा
verses.iast:
kim vaiṣṇavam vā kapirūpametya |
rakṣovināśāya param sutejaḥ |
anantamavyaktamacintyamekam |
svamāyayā sāmpratamāgatam vā
verses.translation: "Or whether a supreme bright energy of Vishnu, the lord of maintenance of the Universe, unthinkable, unmanifest, infinite and pearless, arrived now, assuming the form of a monkey for the destruction of demons, by virtue of Her extraordinary power?"

glosses.meaning: assuming the form of a monkey
by virtue of Her extra ordinary power?

verses.devanagari:
इत्येवमूचुर्बहवो विशिष्टा |
रक्षोगणास्तत्र समेत्य सर्वे |
सप्राणिसम्घां सगृहाम् सवृक्षाम् |
दग्धाम् पुरीम् ताम् सहसा समीक्ष्य
verses.iast:
ityevamūcurbahavo viśiṣṭā |
rakṣogaṇāstatra sametya sarve |
saprāṇisamghāṃ sagṛhām savṛkṣām |
dagdhām purīm tām sahasā samīkṣya
verses.translation: Thus spoke all those excellent troops of demons in multitude, gathering together there, on seeing that city scorched so soon, with its host of living beings, houses and trees.

glosses.meaning: with its host of living beings

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तु लङ्का सहसा प्रदग्धा |
सराक्षसा साश्वरथा सनागा |
सपक्षिसम्घा समृगा सवृक्षा |
रुरोद दीना तुमुलम् सशब्दम्
verses.iast:
tatastu laṇ^kā sahasā pradagdhā |
sarākṣasā sāśvarathā sanāgā |
sapakṣisamghā samṛgā savṛkṣā |
ruroda dīnā tumulam saśabdam
verses.translation: Then, Lanka having been scorched with its demons, horses, chariots, elephants, multitude of birds, animals and trees, cried pitiably with tumultuous noise.

verses.devanagari:
हा तात हा पुत्रक कान्त मित्र |
हा जीवितम् भोगयुतम् सुपुण्यम् |
रक्षोभिरेवम् बहुधा ब्रुवद्भिः |
शब्दः कृतो घोररवः सुभीमः
verses.iast:
hā tāta hā putraka kānta mitra |
hā jīvitam bhogayutam supuṇyam |
rakṣobhirevam bahudhā bruvadbhiḥ |
śabdaḥ kṛto ghoraravaḥ subhīmaḥ
verses.translation: Making a very terrific noise with a dreadful sound, the demons cried in various ways as follows: "O my dear beloved son! O my beloved husband! O my friend! O my very auspicious life, filled with enjoyments!"

verses.devanagari:
हुताशनज्वालसमावृता सा |
हतप्रवीरा परिवृत्तयोधा |
हनूमतः क्रोधबलाभिभूता |
बभूव शापोपहतेअ लङ्का
verses.iast:
hutāśanajvālasamāvṛtā sā |
hatapravīrā parivṛttayodhā |
hanūmataḥ krodhabalābhibhūtā |
babhūva śāpopahatea laṇ^kā
verses.translation: That Lanka appeared as though afflicted by a curse, as defeated by a strong fury of Hanuma, enveloped by flames of fire, with its distinguished heroes killed and with its warriors in retreat.

verses.devanagari:
स सम्भ्रामत्रस्तविषण्णराक्षसां |
समुज्ज्वलज्ज्वालहुताशनाङ्किताम् |
ददर्श लङ्काम् हनुमान् महामानाः |
स्वयम्भूकोपोपहतामिवावनिम्
verses.iast:
sa sambhrāmatrastaviṣaṇṇarākṣasāṃ |
samujjvalajjvālahutāśanāṇ^kitām |
dadarśa laṇ^kām hanumān mahāmānāḥ |
svayambhūkopopahatāmivāvanim
verses.translation: Hanuma, with his great mind, saw Lanka with its dazed, frightened and dejected demons, marked by blazing flames of fire and afflicted by the fury of Brahma the creator of the universe.

glosses.meaning: marked by blazing flames of fire
afflicted by the fury of Brahama

verses.devanagari:
भम्क्त्वा वनम् पादपरत्नसम्कुलम् |
हत्वा तु रक्षांसि महान्ति सम्युगे |
दग्ध्वा पुरीम् ताम् गृहरत्नमालिनीम् |
तस्थौ हनूमान् पवनात्मजः कपिः
verses.iast:
bhamktvā vanam pādaparatnasamkulam |
hatvā tu rakṣāṃsi mahānti samyuge |
dagdhvā purīm tām gṛharatnamālinīm |
tasthau hanūmān pavanātmajaḥ kapiḥ
verses.translation: After demolishing the garden which was full of excellent trees, killing great demons in battle and burning that city endowed with a series of excellent houses, Hanuma the monkey and the son of wind-god, stood at ease.

glosses.meaning: which was full of excellent trees
the monkey and son of wind-god
endowed with a series of excellent houses

verses.devanagari:
त्रिकूटशृङ्गाग्रतले विचित्रे |
प्रतिष्ठितो वानरराजसिम्हः |
प्रदीप्तलाङ्गूलकृतार्चिमाली |
व्यराजतादित्य इवांशुमाली
verses.iast:
trikūṭaśṛṇ^gāgratale vicitre |
pratiṣṭhito vānararājasimhaḥ |
pradīptalāṇ^gūlakṛtārcimālī |
vyarājatāditya ivāṃśumālī
verses.translation: Standing there on the wonderful flat summit of Mount Trikuta, Hanuma the foremost leader of the monkeys, having a garland of flames formed by his blazing tail, shone like the sun having a garland of rays.

glosses.meaning: on the wonderful flat summit of Mount Trikuta
having a garland of flames formed by his blazing tail

verses.devanagari:
स राक्षसांस्तान् सुबहूंश्च हत्वा |
वनम् च भम्क्त्वा बहूपादपम् तत् |
विसृज्य रक्षोभवनेषु चाग्निम् |
जगाम रामम् मनसा महात्मा
verses.iast:
sa rākṣasāṃstān subahūṃśca hatvā |
vanam ca bhamktvā bahūpādapam tat |
visṛjya rakṣobhavaneṣu cāgnim |
jagāma rāmam manasā mahātmā
verses.translation: Killing those multitudes of demons, demolishing that garden endowed with several trees and scattering fire on the houses of demons, the high-souled Hanuma sought Rama with his mind.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तु तम् वानवीरमुख्यम् |
महाबलम् मारुततुल्यवेगम् |
महामतिम् वायुसुतम् वरिष्ठम् |
प्रतुष्टवुर्देवगणाश्च सर्वे
verses.iast:
tatastu tam vānavīramukhyam |
mahābalam mārutatulyavegam |
mahāmatim vāyusutam variṣṭham |
pratuṣṭavurdevagaṇāśca sarve
verses.translation: Then, all the multitude of celestials enlogised that Hanuma, the principal warrior of the monkeys, possessing great strength and swiftness similar to the wind, greatly intelligent and the most excellent.

glosses.meaning: and swiftness equal to the wind

verses.devanagari:
भम्क्त्वा वनम् महातेजा हत्वा रक्षांसि सम्युगे |
दग्ध्वा लङ्कापुरीम् रम्याम् रराज स महाकपिः
verses.iast:
bhamktvā vanam mahātejā hatvā rakṣāṃsi samyuge |
dagdhvā laṇ^kāpurīm ramyām rarāja sa mahākapiḥ
verses.translation: Demolishing the garden, killing the demons in battle, Hanuma of great splendour shone brightly, after burning the beautiful City of Lanka.

verses.devanagari:
तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्ष्यः |
दृष्ट्वा लङ्काम् प्रद्ग्धाम् ताम् विस्मयम् परमम् गताः
verses.iast:
tatra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣyaḥ |
dṛṣṭvā laṇ^kām pradgdhām tām vismayam paramam gatāḥ
verses.translation: Seeing that city of Lanka burnt there, celestials, saints and great sages along with celestial's musicians, got a colossal surprise.

verses.devanagari:
तम् दृष्ट्वा वानरश्रेष्ठम् हनुमन्तम् महाकपिम् |
कालाग्निरिति संचिन्त्य सर्वभूतानि तत्रसुः
verses.iast:
tam dṛṣṭvā vānaraśreṣṭham hanumantam mahākapim |
kālāgniriti saṃcintya sarvabhūtāni tatrasuḥ
verses.translation: Seeing that Hanuma, the foremost among the monkeys and a mighty monkey, all the created beings were frightened, thinking of him as a fire that is to destroy the world.

glosses.meaning: to be a fire that is to destroy the world.

verses.devanagari:
देवाश्च सर्वे मुनिपुङ्गवाश्च |
गन्धर्वविद्याधरनागयक्षाः |
भूतानि सर्वाणि महान्ति तत्र |
जग्मुः पराम् प्रीतिमतुल्यरूपाम्
verses.iast:
devāśca sarve munipuṇ^gavāśca |
gandharvavidyādharanāgayakṣāḥ |
bhūtāni sarvāṇi mahānti tatra |
jagmuḥ parām prītimatulyarūpām
verses.translation: There, all the celestial musicians, Vidyadharas the supernatural beings, Nagas the celestial serpents, Yakshas the spirits and all great living beings attained a great joy.
